attribution.method: per-site sensitivity: one site's int8 step scaled at a time in the REAL converted graph (params-only edit; shapes and roots unchanged), evaluated on held-out cases; plus operand-balancing and weight-MSE experiments

dominant_sources.k_path: k is by far the most sensitive site (4x step -> cosine 0.64); its tail comes from the pinned k_norm weight (max ~96.5). Best measured k tuning (per-head MSE step x0.25) lifts the gate from 0.951 to 0.964
dominant_sources.distributed_activation_error: h, h2, ctx, gate, up, down, hm and o_proj each cost roughly 0.89-0.93 cosine at 2x step; no single site dominates after the k tuning
dominant_sources.not_the_bottleneck: weight quantization (MSE-optimal weight scales change the gate by <0.001) and the canonical arithmetic itself (Go/Python bit-exact; op-level mirror matches the real graph bit-for-bit)

attribution.expressivity_limit: one static scale per tensor: with single-scale int8 activations the heavy-tailed channels (k_norm up to 96.5, q_norm up to 11.8) force a step that destroys the many small-magnitude channels; operand balancing (exact per-channel MUL constants q*t vs k/t) measured WORSE (0.83 at full balance), and per-channel/per-block activation scales are not expressible with the frozen operator set (the RMSNorm couples the full head before quantization)
attribution.proposed_extension_not_implemented: per the Phase F.1 rules a protocol extension is only PROPOSED here, never applied: a versioned REQUANTIZE form with per-slice steps, or an explicit canonical slice/view tensor op, would let the tail channels take their own step

verdict_reason: predeclared thresholds (worst cosine >= 0.995, worst max_abs <= 0.05) are not reachable for this real layer under the frozen single-scale static W8A8 scheme; thresholds are NOT adjusted (Phase F.1 section 28) and REAL_MODEL_BLOCK is reported FAIL with the error sources located
